reasons.claim: 8 eligible species (threatened VU, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound) are recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m. Nearest is Alectoria sarmentosa (VU, lichen) at 472 m, many 2026 records with 10 m uncertainty. Others: Ramaria boreimaxima, Tricholoma colossus, Hydnellum scabrosum, Tricholoma sudum, Goodyera repens, Tragosoma depsarium, Collema subnigrescens.
No records inside or within 250 m of the polygon (0 records, 0 days), while effort within 1000 m is adequate: 148 records, 82 species, 33 days vs county median 66 (78th percentile).
Completed felling covers only 1.2% of the polygon (April 2026).
Notification: 1.1 ha polygon, regeneration felling, status notified.
Rubric hint is MEDIUM; I follow it.

uncertainties: Records lie 472 m or more from the polygon, so they do not show these species occupy the site.
Nothing recorded near the site could reflect where observers went rather than what grows there, though effort around it is adequate.
11 red-listed species were not shown in the output.
not_established: Does not establish that any listed species is present or absent on the polygon.
Does not show the site is safe to fell.
Does not establish whether the habitat on the polygon resembles the record locations.
next_action: A reviewer should compare the polygon's habitat with the nearby record locations, especially the 2026 Alectoria sarmentosa records at 472 m, and consider a field check before felling starts.
